_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

title.en: You are allowed to be scared

body.en: Money, space, whether you will be any good at this. Fathers rarely say these out loud because it feels selfish next to what she is carrying. Saying one of them to her this week is not a burden. It is the beginning of doing this together.
body.hi: पैसा, जगह, यह कि आप इसमें अच्छे होंगे या नहीं। पिता ये बातें कम ही कहते हैं, क्योंकि वे जो उठा रही हैं उसके आगे यह स्वार्थी लगता है। इस हफ़्ते इनमें से एक बात उनसे कह देना बोझ नहीं है। यह इसे साथ मिलकर करने की शुरुआत है।
